відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"For a 20-minute walk to work in deep frost and snow, I built the outfit in layers: the boots, the coat, the scarf and the beanie do the weather work, while the sweater and trousers keep it suited to an office day. The coat is the outer layer, and the scarf and beanie finish it around the face and head. Everything stays at a working-day level, so you arrive looking ready for the office, not dressed for the street. The bag completes the outfit.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wrap the scarf around your neck and tuck its ends inside the coat, so the cold doesn't get in at the chest.\",\"Raise the coat collar over the scarf for the walk: it adds a vertical line near your face and keeps the wind out.\",\"Pull the beanie down over your ears for the frost, and take it off at the office.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#153·10\",\"what\":\"sweater\"},{\"n\":\"#488·04\",\"what\":\"trousers\"},{\"n\":\"#24·04\",\"what\":\"coat\"},{\"n\":\"#536·05\",\"what\":\"ankle boots\"},{\"n\":\"#186·45\",\"what\":\"bag\"},{\"n\":\"#218·44\",\"what\":\"scarf\"},{\"n\":\"#491·30\",\"what\":\"beanie\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#153·10\",\"text\":\"The sweater suits an office day, and its knit works for the frost you'll walk through, so it is a sound base under the coat.\"},{\"n\":\"#488·04\",\"text\":\"The trousers sit at the right level for work and give the outfit a calm, tidy lower half.\"},{\"n\":\"#24·04\",\"text\":\"The coat is the main protection on your walk: the wool in it ranks it above other outer layers in deep frost, and it is smart enough for the office.\"},{\"n\":\"#536·05\",\"text\":\"The ankle boots are at the right level for a working day and suit a walk through snow.\"},{\"n\":\"#218·44\",\"text\":\"The scarf is made for deep frost and carries the colour near your face, so the sweater doesn't have to.\"},{\"n\":\"#491·30\",\"text\":\"I chose the beanie on purpose: in deep frost, on a 20-minute walk, covering your head matters more than anything else. Keep the scarf wrapped close to your face so its tone isn't alone up at the top.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":23935,"output_tokens":1432},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
